newsitem.title: UK: INTERVIEW-David Smith sees poor conditions.
newsitem.headline: INTERVIEW-David Smith sees poor conditions.

text.p: British packaging and paper firm David S. Smith said on Wednesday it expected poor trading conditions to continue into the first half of next financial year, citing weakness in the French and German economies. Earlier the company warned that its second half earnings this financial year would fall below the first half's level.

When asked whether the poor trading conditions would continue into next year, chief executive Peter Williams said, "We think it's unlikely to be just the second half. We would think it would continue into the first half of next year."
Williams declined to give earnings estimates for the first half of next financial year.
"I'm not about to make a forecast, but I think you can surmise from that that it's unlikely to be at this year's (first half) level," he said in an interview.
The company reported pre-tax profits of 58.6 million stg for the first half ended November 2, down from 59.6 million stg in the year-ago period.
The results topped most analysts' expectations, which ranged from 52.0 to 58.0 million stg.
